summary: Anthropic announced an expanded partnership with Cognizant, under which Cognizant will embed Claude across its own platforms, scale a Claude-certified workforce, and become a Global Premier Partner in the Claude Partner Network to deliver Claude-based solutions to enterprise clients.

practices.reason: The described spec-driven development pattern (directing Claude Code with specifications, coding standards and architectural blueprints, then evaluating output before production) is a technique worth noting but is specific to Cognizant's proprietary Flowsource platform and not concretely transferable.
practices.quote: lowsource directs Claude Code using the specifications, coding standards, and architectural blueprints a project defines, then and then evaluates the output before production.
